==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' states that Trench is "well into his second century" by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which begin in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. This would place his birth sometime between 222 and [[122 BBY]].
